subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR land with `announceLastRun` persisted session state, `killed` reconciliation for aborted announce turns, and mandatory tool-free subagent completion announce handoffs?
rationale: The code looks directionally correct, but the remaining choice changes persisted session recovery semantics and a security-relevant tool boundary, which needs maintainer ownership rather than automated repair.

options.title: Accept current recovery and tool model
options.body: Rerun or clear hosted lint, then land the PR with `announceLastRun`, `killed` recovery reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery.

options.title: Choose a different terminal state
options.body: Update the recovery reconciliation if maintainers want a non-running state other than `killed` for aborted delivery-only announce turns.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a generic inter-session delivery-turn recovery model instead of an announce-specific marker.

recommendation.title: Accept current recovery and tool model
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear hosted lint, then land the PR with `announceLastRun`, `killed` recovery reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both restart recovery lifecycle seams and Codex internal-turn behavior touched by this PR.
